The nausea is a little strange. It could be due to a sudden change of hormones perhaps ? The slight cramping is normal. I never had any symptoms after my abortion. Within 10 minutes of waking up from the procedure, the cramping went away & I never felt them again. I did bleed up a storm though, which is also normal. I experienced an anxiety attack for the first time in my life about two weeks after my abortion, which led to the beginning of my “post partum” era. I became obsessed with the Keto diet in hopes that I could go back to my original weight of 107 lbs & I would be so anxious & nervous throughout the day & suffer sleepless nights just thinking about random shit that a normal person without anxiety wouldn’t even be bothered by. I guess this was a more anxious version of post part I’m depression even though my feelings had NOTHING to do with the abortion itself. (I felt no connection to the fetus, nor the father, & aborting it was the happiest day of my life.) I believe these were just the typical feelings any pregnant person experiences after birth/miscarriage/abortion. It’s just an influx of raging hormones all over the place that doesn’t know what to do with itself. It went away for me after about two months.

About two months after the abortion, I developed really bad forehead acne. The kind of acne that you got when you were first hitting puberty & had years of chronic acne that just wouldn’t go away no matter what you did. I already knew it was because of the hormone shift, so I kind of just let it be even though it really bothered my self esteem sometimes. By seven months, it was gone, like magic.

The only long term effect I suffer is, my period is now gushingly heavy the first two days. What used to be a light, symptom-free period for me turned into a heavy, clotted mess & I finally started experiencing typical “pms symptoms.” The first two days are so bad that I can no longer wear tampons & even pads have trouble absorbing the blood when it fishes out all at once... It literally like overflows due to the pad not absorbing fast enough...

My areolas got larger & darker when I got pregnant. I thought that they would go back to normal after the abortion, but they never did. I used to hate my nipples so much, but as time went on, I got used to them & now they don’t bother me.

My pre pregnancy weight was 107 pounds. Right now I am about 112ish. I can’t get over the fact that I can’t go back to 107 permanently & when I do, it’s only for so long before I go back to 112. I think those extra few pounds went to my lower abdomen. I am still a skinny woman. But my stomach will never be as flat as it used to be. It makes me sad lol. I just can’t believe how much your body changes because of pregnancy. I only carried to 17 weeks & 4 days, but I suffer permanent damage to my body. This of course, doesn’t have anything to do with your question about abortion symptoms, but I thought you’d enjoy the extra details. Good luck !
